DynaMOS is a dynamic schedule migration technique that allows a little InO core to replay OoO issue schedules, and thereby achieve energy-efficiency and performance.

, in the context of a multicore system with a big and a little core, DynaM OS is a mechanism to dynamically offload recurring issue sequences from the big core to the little core to increase the utilization of the little core and thereby achieve energy-efficiency.

a heterogeneous multicore system can be used to achieve energy-efficient OoO execution by exploiting the dynamic behavior of a program.
a little core can achieve the performance of an OoO core at a fraction of its energy cost, by offloading recurring issue schedules from an OoO big core to the little.
